verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Grace that flows like a river
Washing over me
Fount of heaven, love of Christ
Overflow in me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Thank You Jesus
You set me free
Christ my Saviour
You've rescued me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Take this life delivered
A vessel of Your love
Wholly now devoted
To see Your kingdom come

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
You've given me life
You've opened my eyes
I love You Lord
I love You Lord

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
You've entered my heart
You've set me apart
I love You Lord
I love You Lord
